Package arcade.core.sim.input

Class InputBuilder

java.lang.Object
arcade.core.sim.input.InputBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContentHandler
Direct Known Subclasses:
PatchInputBuilder, PottsInputBuilder
public abstract class InputBuilder extends Object implements ContentHandler
Custom builder for simulation setup XMLs.

The class checks for specific tags, which determine where the parsed data is placed for further processing by the Series class. Once the end tag for a given <series> is reached, a new Series object is instantiated. All content in the setup XML is stored as attribute-value pairs; there is no content between tags (the characters method is not used).

General structure of the XML file (attributes not listed): 

     <set>
         <series>
             <simulation />
             <agents />
             <environment />
         </series>
         ...
     </set>

  • Method Details

    • build

      public ArrayList<Series> build(String xml) throws IOException, SAXException
      Builds Series from the given XML file.

      Reads through the setup XML file using an SAX parser with custom defined content handler, which creates the Series objects as they are parsed. SAX parses XML files using event handlers and so does not load the entire XML file into memory (in contrast to DOM).

      Parameters:
      xml - the XML file
      Returns:
      a list of Series instances
      Throws:
      IOException
      SAXException
